The smallest valid repair is to remove that self-referential frame reference by expressing the intended tool +y/tool +z orthogonality indirectly: since tool +z is constrained antiparallel to world +z, keeping tool +y orthogonal to world +z preserves the intended orthogonality without referencing the same frame as both controlled and reference.

The first axis_align term encodes tool +z antiparallel to world +z within 0.05 rad. The second axis_align term encodes tool +y orthogonal to strawberry_center_frame +x within 0.05 rad. The final repaired axis_align term avoids the invalid self-reference and keeps tool +y orthogonal to world +z, which, together with the tool +z antiparallel-to-world +z constraint, preserves tool +y orthogonal to tool +z. Continuous monitoring and fail/pause behavior are represented only through the maintained gripper_opened and geometry condition labels because explicit runtime monitoring/failure logic is not directly encoded by the available terms.
